|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on Death Star. During your control phase, opponent loses 2 Force for each battleground system within 2 parsecs of your Death Star that you control with a Star Destroyer.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Fear Will Keep Them In Line (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Unless [Virtual] Fear Will Keep Them In Line on table (even if suspended), deploy on Death Star. During your control phase, for each battleground system controlled by your Star Destroyer within 2 parsecs of Death Star, opponent loses 2 Force.” '''What changed:''' “Deploy” → “Unless [Virtual] Fear Will Keep Them In Line on table (even if suspended), deploy”; removed “opponent loses 2 Force”; added “controlled by your Star Destroyer”; removed “your”; “Star that you control with a Star Destroyer.” → “Star, opponent loses 2 Force.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 3, slip 32. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Fear Will Keep Them In Line]].
* Later text: [[Fear Will Keep Them In Line (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
